    hi where hi < 0. That value is a projection gap, not a distance along the line, so the value may
    jump where the line starts or stops meeting r; its sign gives the side in both cases. Undefined
    where the line meets r both ahead and behind, where it misses r and [lo, hi] spans or touches
    zero, and where
    r's boundary is not a simple polygon (an empty list, fewer than three vertices, zero area, or a
    boundary that crosses or touches itself); unknown where the position, the direction (a zero
    vector included) or the boundary is absent. Independent of the boundary's start vertex and
    orientation. The direction is normalised as `st_lane_direction` is read (`Geom.unit`, with Core's
    micrometre-rounded square root), and the distance is counted in lengths of that normalised
    vector, which lie between 1 and 1 + 2·10⁻⁶ m. The value is geometry only: it does not establish
    that x is on l, that r marks l's entrance, that x's whole body has crossed r, or that a crossing
    happened between observations, and a distance to r is read from `st_region_geometry_distance`. -/
def prim_region_offset_along (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r l : RegionId) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
    let some u := (st_lane_direction s l).bind Geom.unit | throw (.absentAtom "st_lane_direction")
    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
    if !simpleIn c r poly then throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
    let ts := Geom.lineCrossings p u poly
    if Geom.inPolygon p poly || Geom.onBoundary p poly then pure Q.zero
    else match ts with
      | [] =>
        match poly.map fun q => Q.div (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub q p) u) (Geom.dot u u) with
        | [] => throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
        | t :: rest =>
          if (t :: rest).all (Q.lt Q.zero ·) then pure (rest.foldl Q.min t)
          else if (t :: rest).all (Q.lt · Q.zero) then pure (rest.foldl Q.max t)
          else throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
      | t :: rest =>
        if ts.all (Q.lt Q.zero ·) then pure (rest.foldl Q.min t)
        else if ts.all (Q.lt · Q.zero) then pure (rest.foldl Q.max t)
        else throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant (`Term.distanceWhile`). -/
def distanceWhile (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  Temporal.distanceWhileAll (pathPos c x) holds

/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of road user x since ψ last became true
    (`Term.headingSince`), integrated from the yaw rate as `prim_heading_change` integrates it, with
    `maxStep` bounding every interval from the one ending at the start. -/
def headingSince (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (maxStep : Q) (ψ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  Accumulate.sinceRiseIntegralAll c.times (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x)) maxStep "heading_since"
    (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate") ψ

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tables and dispatch by name
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Every `prim_*` definition of this file. The doctor holds this against `primitiveIds`. -/
def primitiveNames : List String :=
  ["prim_heading_change", "prim_closest_approach_within", "prim_closest_approach_time",
   "prim_closest_approach_distance", "prim_conditions_hold", "prim_region_lateral_offset",
   "prim_region_offset_along"]

/-- The atoms each primitive reads (Lean names of Atoms.lean); Manifest.lean turns a primitive
    into the atoms a source must observe. -/
def reads (n : String) : List String :=
  match n with
  | "prim_heading_change" => ["kin_yaw_rate"]
  | "prim_closest_approach_within" | "prim_closest_approach_time" | "prim_closest_approach_distance" => ["kin_position", "kin_velocity"]
  | "prim_conditions_hold" => ["dev_zone_sign", "dev_regulatory_sign", "env_civil_time", "ru_occupant_count", "ru_child"]
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset" => ["kin_position", "kin_heading", "st_region_geometry"]
  | "prim_region_offset_along" => ["kin_position", "st_lane_direction", "st_region_geometry"]
  | _ => []

/-- The sort each entity argument of a primitive must have (`none` marks a literal or natural
    position). The static check holds variables to these. -/
def argSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
  let t := some EntityKind.track
  match name with
  | "prim_heading_change" => some [t]
  | "prim_closest_approach_within" | "prim_closest_approach_time" | "prim_closest_approach_distance" => some [t, t]
  | "prim_conditions_hold" => some [some EntityKind.device, t]
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset" => some [t, some EntityKind.region]
  | "prim_region_offset_along" => some [t, some EntityKind.region, some EntityKind.region]
  | _ => none

private def tid (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n n => .ok n | _ => .error (.malformed "entity")

/-- A name no primitive carries: a concept call that no expansion replaced, or a misspelling. -/
private def unknownName (n : String) : UnknownReason :=
  if primitiveNames.contains n then .malformed s!"arity {n}" else .malformed s!"concept {n}"

/-- Boolean primitives by name. Unlisted names and wrong arities are `malformed`. -/
def evalB (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason (Array R) :=
  match name, args, ps with
  | "prim_closest_approach_within", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_within c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_conditions_hold", [d, x], [] => do pure (prim_conditions_hold c (← tid d) (← tid x))
  | n, _, _ => .error (unknownName n)

/-- Quantity-valued primitives by name. -/
def evalQ (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason (Array QR) :=
  match name, args, ps with
  | "prim_heading_change", [x], [w] => do pure (prim_heading_change c (← tid x) w)
  | "prim_closest_approach_time", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_time c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_closest_approach_distance", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_distance c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset", [x, r], [] => do pure (prim_region_lateral_offset c (← tid x) (← tid r))
  | "prim_region_offset_along", [x, r, l], [] => do pure (prim_region_offset_along c (← tid x) (← tid r) (← tid l))
  | n, _, _ => .error (unknownName n)


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: a primitive returns one value per observation.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
theorem size_each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : (each c f).size = c.n := by simp [each, Ctx.n]
theorem size_eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : (eachQ c f).size = c.n := by simp [eachQ, Ctx.n]
theorem size_prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : (prim_heading_change c x w).size = c.n := by
  simp [prim_heading_change, yawChange]
theorem size_distanceWhile (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (holds : Array R) :
    (distanceWhile c x holds).size = holds.size := by
  simp [distanceWhile, Temporal.size_distanceWhileAll]
theorem size_headingSince (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (g : Q) (ψ : Array R) :
    (headingSince c x g ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  simp [headingSince, Accumulate.size_sinceRiseIntegralAll]

/-- A Boolean primitive that returns an array returns one value per observation. -/
theorem size_evalB (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) (a : Array R)
    (h : evalB name c args ps = .ok a) : a.size = c.n := by
  unfold evalB at h
  split at h <;> (try simp only [bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h) <;> (repeat' split at h) <;>
    first | (cases h; simp [prim_closest_approach_within, prim_conditions_hold, size_each]) | cases h

/-- A quantity primitive that returns an array returns one value per observation. -/
theorem size_evalQ (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) (a : Array QR)
    (h : evalQ name c args ps = .ok a) : a.size = c.n := by
  unfold evalQ at h
  split at h <;> (try simp only [bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h) <;> (repeat' split at h) <;>
    first
    | (cases h; simp [prim_heading_change, yawChange, prim_closest_approach_time, prim_closest_approach_distance,
                      prim_region_lateral_offset, prim_region_offset_along, size_eachQ, Ctx.n])
    | cases h

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- One integral, one interval convention, one unit

105	def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
106	  (List.range n).map fun k =>

116	    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
117	    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
118	    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
119	    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
120	    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }

134	    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
135	    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
136	    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
137	    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
138	    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
139	    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
140	    far enough to decide it. -/
141	structure Scenario where
142	  name : String
143	  rule : String
144	  trace : Trace
145	  reading : Reading
146	  manifest : Manifest
147	  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
148	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
149	  expected : Verdict
150	  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
151	  boundary : String := ""
152	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
153	
154	namespace Scenario
155	/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
156	    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
157	def pastOps : List String :=
158	  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
159	   "heading_since"]
160	
161	/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
162	    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
163	    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
164	    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
165	    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
166	    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
167	    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
168	    `unknown` witness only.
169	    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
170	    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
171	def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
172	  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
173	  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
174	    | some r => pure r
175	    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
176	  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
177	    | .ok S => pure S
178	    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
179	  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
180	    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
181	      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
182	  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
183	  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
184	  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
185	    match sc.window with
186	    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
187	    | none => true
188	  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
189	  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
190	    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
191	  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
192	    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
193	  match sc.expected with
194	  | .notApplicable =>
195	    if tl.present then pure got
196	    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
197	  | .unknown _ =>
198	    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
199	    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
200	    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
201	      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
202	      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
203	    if !stray.isEmpty then
204	      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
205	    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
206	      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
207	    else pure got
208	  | _ => pure got
209	end Scenario
210	
211	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.

  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.

  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
  writes through a `Units` constructor.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Build

/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))

def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)

/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track
    classes := some classes
    kin := { position := some pos
             heading := some heading
             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
             speed := some speed
             extent := some halfExtent
             pathLength := pathLength } }

/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }

def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }

/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/

  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/

  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  { id := id
    kind := .lane
    boundary := some boundary
    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
                   entersIntersection := enters } }
def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }

def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }

/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match u.kin.position with
    | none => []
    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
      | none => none

/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
  { t := t
    subject := subject
    users := users
    structures := structures
    devices := devices
    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
    env := env
    assumptions := assumptions
    intents := intents }

/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range n).map fun k =>
    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    f k t

/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
  Typed reasons for an unknown verdict, and the three-valued result that carries them.

  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that
  produces `u` attaches a reason; the connectives keep the reasons of their unknown operands and
  drop them once a value is decided.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles

namespace TrafficSpec

inductive UnknownReason
  | absentAtom (name : String)            -- the source did not observe this atom for this entity
  | samplingGap (op : String)             -- observations too sparse for the window
  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
  | divisionByZero (what : String)
  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace UnknownReason
/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
def tag : UnknownReason → String
  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
end UnknownReason

/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
structure R where
  v : Tri
  why : List UnknownReason := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace R
def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
  match o with
  | some b => ofBool b
  | none => u w
/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl
def implies (a b : R) : R := or (not a) b
def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
  match o with
  | some a => k a
  | none => u w
end R

/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q

/-- Kleene conjunction and disjunction over index ranges of a per-instant array in O(1) each,
    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
structure RangeAgg where
  vals : Array R
  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
  prefT : Array Nat
  prefU : Array Nat
  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)

namespace RangeAgg
def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
  let n := vals.size
  let count (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
    (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩

private def cnt (pref : Array Nat) (lo hi : Nat) : Nat := pref[hi + 1]! - pref[lo]!
private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []

/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.t
/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.f

/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)

private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [countTo]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
    split
    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]

theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ b ih =>

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_208_1

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pFollowingDecelDry : Term := .param "p.following_decel_dry"
def pFollowingDecelIce : Term := .param "p.following_decel_ice"
def pFollowingDecelWet : Term := .param "p.following_decel_wet"
def pFollowingHeadwayDry : Term := .param "p.following_headway_dry"
def pFollowingHeadwayIce : Term := .param "p.following_headway_ice"
def pFollowingHeadwayWet : Term := .param "p.following_headway_wet"
def pLeftLaneMoveOverTime : Term := .param "p.left_lane_move_over_time"
def pOvertakeSameDirectionCos : Term := .param "p.overtake_same_direction_cos"
def pOvertakeWindow : Term := .param "p.overtake_window"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- k3: "two or more … lanes": the text's literal. -/
def twoLanes : Term := .lit (Units.ratio 2 1) .count

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helpers
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def allOf : List Formula → Formula
  | [] => .tt
  | [φ] => φ
  | φ :: rest => .and φ (allOf rest)

def anyOf : List Formula → Formula
  | [] => .ff
  | [φ] => φ
  | φ :: rest => .or φ (anyOf rest)

def aggMotorVehicle : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle"
def aggVehicle : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"
def aggHighOccupancy : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-460-2::high_occupancy_vehicle"
def aggTraffic : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"
def aggEmergency : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle"

def member (x agg : String) : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [.var x, .lit agg] []
def occupies (x r : String) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [.var x, .var r] []
def governs (d r : String) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [.var d, .var r] []
def speedOf (x : String) : Term := .measure "kin_speed" [.var x]
/-- A road user other than the subject. -/
def other (x : String) : Formula := .not (.same (.var x) vSubject)

/-- sig.warning_lamp of a colour in a mode, on the subject. -/
def lamp (colour mode : String) : Formula := .atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vSubject, .lit colour, .lit mode] []
def flashingOrRotating (colour : String) : Formula := .or (lamp colour "flashing") (lamp colour "rotating")

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class, place
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := member "subject" aggMotorVehicle

/-- k2: the subject occupies a controlled-access highway. -/
def onControlledAccess (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "controlled_access") ("ca" ++ sfx) (occupies "subject" ("ca" ++ sfx))

/-- k3, k4: the subject occupies a lane that is first from the left of two or more lanes in its
    direction. -/
def inExtremeLeftLane (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let l := "lane" ++ sfx
  let n := "leftNeighbour" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") l (allOf
    [ occupies "subject" l
    , .cmp (.measure "st_lane_adjacency" [.var l, .lit "count"]) .ge twoLanes
    , .not (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") n (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var l, .lit "left", .var n] [])) ])

/-- k5: the subject's speed is below the value of a maximum speed-limit sign governing a travel
    region it occupies. -/
def belowPostedLimit (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let d := "limitSign" ++ sfx
  let r := "portion" ++ sfx
  .existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_sign") d (allOf
    [ .atom "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind" [.var d, .lit "maximum"] []
    , .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") r (.and (occupies "subject" r) (governs d r))
    , .cmp (speedOf "subject") .lt (.measure "dev_speed_limit_sign_value" [.var d]) ])

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exceptions read inside S
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- k9: within the window ahead, the subject overtakes and passes another vehicle. -/
def overtaking (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let c := "passed" ++ sfx
  .within .time pOvertakeWindow "subject" (.existsUser c (allOf
    [ other c
    , member c aggVehicle
    , .derived "drv_interaction_overtake_pass" [vSubject, .var c] [pOvertakeWindow, pOvertakeSameDirectionCos] ]))

/-- k10, k11: the subject's declared plan includes a left turn at an intersection. -/
def preparingLeftTurn (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let i := "turnAt" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") i (.intent "int.left_turn" vSubject (.var i))

/-- k12, k13a, k13b: the subject travels in a high-occupancy lane, is a high-occupancy vehicle, and
    the conditions of every high-occupancy-lane zone sign governing that lane hold for it. -/
def inHovLaneComplying (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let r := "hovLane" ++ sfx
  let z := "hovSign" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "reserved_lane") r (allOf
    [ occupies "subject" r
    , .atom "st_reserved_lane_class" [.var r, .lit "high_occupancy"] []
    , member "subject" aggHighOccupancy
    , .forallDevice (.lit "zone_sign") z
        (.implies
          (.and (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [.var z, .lit "high_occupancy_lane"] []) (governs z r))
          (.derived "prim_conditions_hold" [.var z, vSubject] [])) ])

/-- k14: a highway-maintenance vehicle at work: amber warning lamp flashing or rotating. -/
def engagedInRoadWork : Formula :=
  allOf
    [ .atom "ru_official_vehicle" [vSubject] []
    , .atom "ru_official_vehicle_kind" [vSubject, .lit "highway_maintenance"] []
    , flashingOrRotating "amber" ]

/-- k16 operationalization: the stopping distance S_stop = speed × H + speed² / (D + D). -/
def stopping (h d : Term) : Term :=
  .add (.mul (speedOf "subject") h) (.div (.mul (speedOf "subject") (speedOf "subject")) (.add d d))

def surfaceIcy : Formula := .atom "env_ice_or_snow" [] []
def surfaceWet : Formula := .or (.atom "env_wet_road" [] []) (.atom "env_precipitation" [] [])

def stoppingDistance : Term :=
  .cond surfaceIcy (stopping pFollowingHeadwayIce pFollowingDecelIce)
    (.cond surfaceWet (stopping pFollowingHeadwayWet pFollowingDecelWet)
      (stopping pFollowingHeadwayDry pFollowingDecelDry))

/-- The lane to the right of a lane the subject occupies, and what holds of it. -/
def rightLaneOf (sfx : String) (body : String → Formula) : Formula :=
  let ls := "ownLane" ++ sfx
  let lr := "rightLane" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") ls (.and (occupies "subject" ls)
    (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") lr
      (.and (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var ls, .lit "right", .var lr] []) (body lr))))

/-- k15, k16 (traffic conditions): a traffic member in the right neighbouring lane within S_stop
    of the subject, longitudinally. -/
def trafficTooClose (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  rightLaneOf ("T" ++ sfx) fun lr =>
    let c := "beside" ++ sfx
    .existsUser c (allOf
      [ other c
      , member c aggTraffic
      , occupies c lr
      , .cmp (.measure "rel_surface_gap" [vSubject, .var c, .lit "longitudinal"]) .lt stoppingDistance ])

/-- k15, k16 (obstructions or hazards): an obstruction on the subject's right within S_stop. -/
def obstructionOnRight (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let o := "obstacle" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "obstruction") o (.and
    (.cmp (.measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [vSubject, .var o]) .lt stoppingDistance)
    (.cmp (.quantity "prim_region_lateral_offset" [vSubject, .var o] []) .lt zeroMetres))

/-- k15, k16 (inclement weather): visibility below S_stop. -/
def visibilityShort : Formula := .cmp (.measure "env_visibility" []) .lt stoppingDistance

/-- k17: a device or a peace officer governing the lane to the right closes it. -/
def rightLaneClosed (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  rightLaneOf ("C" ++ sfx) fun lr =>
    let d1 := "laneSignal" ++ sfx
    let d2 := "closureSign" ++ sfx
    let d3 := "works" ++ sfx
    let d4 := "officer" ++ sfx
    anyOf
      [ .existsDevice (.lit "lane_control_signal") d1 (.and (governs d1 lr)
          (.or (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var d1, .lit "red_x"] [])
               (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var d1, .lit "yellow_x"] [])))
      , .existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") d2 (.and (governs d2 lr)
          (.or (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var d2, .lit "closed_to_traffic"] [])
               (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var d2, .lit "do_not_enter"] [])))
      , .existsDevice (.lit "temporary_traffic_control") d3 (governs d3 lr)
      , .existsDevice (.lit "human_direction") d4 (allOf
          [ governs d4 lr
          , .atom "dev_human_direction_role" [.var d4, .lit "police_officer"] []
          , .atom "dev_human_direction_indication" [.var d4, .lit "stop"] [] ]) ]

/-- None of the exceptions of subsection 2 (a)(1)-(4), (b), (c) holds. -/
def unexcused (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  .not (anyOf
    [ overtaking sfx
    , preparingLeftTurn sfx
    , inHovLaneComplying sfx
    , engagedInRoadWork
    , trafficTooClose sfx
    , obstructionOnRight sfx
    , visibilityShort
    , rightLaneClosed sfx ])

/-- S: the subject is in the extreme left lane of a controlled-access highway of two or more lanes,
    slower than the posted maximum, and unexcused. -/
def stays (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  allOf [ onControlledAccess sfx, inExtremeLeftLane sfx, belowPostedLimit sfx, unexcused sfx ]

/-- k6, O: a faster motor vehicle behind the subject in its lane. -/
def overtakenFromRear (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let c := "rear" ++ sfx
  .existsUser c (allOf
    [ other c
    , member c aggMotorVehicle
    , .atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var c] []
    , .cmp (speedOf c) .gt (speedOf "subject") ])

/-- k4: a motor vehicle is still behind the subject in its lane. -/
def followedInLane (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let c := "follower" ++ sfx
  .existsUser c (allOf
    [ other c
    , member c aggMotorVehicle
    , .atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var c] [] ])

/-- k18: an authorized emergency vehicle on duty: a warning lamp flashing or rotating, or a siren. -/
def aevOnDuty : Formula :=
  .and (member "subject" aggEmergency) (anyOf
    [ flashingOrRotating "red"
    , flashingOrRotating "blue"
    , flashingOrRotating "amber"
    , flashingOrRotating "white"
    , .atom "sig_siren" [vSubject] [] ])

/-- Applicability: k2, k3/k4 (place), not k18, not k20. -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  allOf
    [ onControlledAccess "A"
    , inExtremeLeftLane "A"
    , .not aevOnDuty
    , .not (.asm "asm.within_city_or_town_limits") ]

/-- Obligation: k4 with k5, k6, k9-k17: not (S has held, for the move-over window, since an
    observation at which O and S held together, with a motor vehicle behind the subject now). -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .not (.and
    (.holdsFor .time pLeftLaneMoveOverTime "subject"
      (.since (stays "S") (.and (overtakenFromRear "O") (stays "R"))))
    (followedInLane "F"))

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_208_1"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-208-1"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "subject", cls := clsSubject } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := ["asm.within_city_or_town_limits"]
    intentions := ["int.left_turn"]
    operationalizations :=
      [ { standard := "make it necessary to drive in the extreme left lane"
          concepts := ["env.visibility", "kin.speed", "rel.surface_gap", "st.region_geometry"]
          params := ["p.following_headway_dry", "p.following_headway_wet", "p.following_headway_ice", "p.following_decel_dry", "p.following_decel_wet", "p.following_decel_ice"]
          convention := "Stopping-distance convention: S = speed(subject) × H + speed(subject)² / (2 × D), with H and D selected by the surface (_ice where env.ice_or_snow, _wet where env.wet_road or env.precipitation, else _dry), as for following distance. The left lane is necessary where moving right cannot be done within S: a traffic member occupying the right neighbouring lane has a longitudinal body gap to the subject (rel.surface_gap) below S, or an obstruction lies within ground distance S of the subject on its right (st.region_geometry, prim.region_lateral_offset negative), or the visibility distance (env.visibility) is below S. Each factor enters by degree: the subject's speed and the surface move S; the gap, the distance and the visibility are compared with it."
          surrogate := false } ]
    residues := ["Points to subsection 2, which is appended to this same law line and carried by its own exception spans k8-k20; the duty is the same whether or not these words are read."]  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_208_1

  | [φ] => φ

def occupies (x r : String) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [.var x, .var r] []
def governs (d r : String) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [.var d, .var r] []

/-- k3, k4: the subject occupies a lane that is first from the left of two or more lanes in its
    direction. -/
def inExtremeLeftLane (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let l := "lane" ++ sfx
  let n := "leftNeighbour" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") l (allOf
    [ occupies "subject" l
    , .cmp (.measure "st_lane_adjacency" [.var l, .lit "count"]) .ge twoLanes
    , .not (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") n (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var l, .lit "left", .var n] [])) ])

  let r := "portion" ++ sfx
  .existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_sign") d (allOf
    [ .atom "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind" [.var d, .lit "maximum"] []
    , .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") r (.and (occupies "subject" r) (governs d r))
    , .cmp (speedOf "subject") .lt (.measure "dev_speed_limit_sign_value" [.var d]) ])

def preparingLeftTurn (sfx : String) : Formula :=

    the conditions of every high-occupancy-lane zone sign governing that lane hold for it. -/
def inHovLaneComplying (sfx : String) : Formula :=

  let z := "hovSign" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "reserved_lane") r (allOf
    [ occupies "subject" r
    , .atom "st_reserved_lane_class" [.var r, .lit "high_occupancy"] []
    , member "subject" aggHighOccupancy
    , .forallDevice (.lit "zone_sign") z

          (.derived "prim_conditions_hold" [.var z, vSubject] [])) ])

    , .atom "ru_official_vehicle_kind" [vSubject, .lit "highway_maintenance"] []
    , flashingOrRotating "amber" ]

def stopping (h d : Term) : Term :=
  .add (.mul (speedOf "subject") h) (.div (.mul (speedOf "subject") (speedOf "subject")) (.add d d))

def surfaceIcy : Formula := .atom "env_ice_or_snow" [] []
def surfaceWet : Formula := .or (.atom "env_wet_road" [] []) (.atom "env_precipitation" [] [])

def stoppingDistance : Term :=
  .cond surfaceIcy (stopping pFollowingHeadwayIce pFollowingDecelIce)

def trafficTooClose (sfx : String) : Formula :=

      , member c aggTraffic

               (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var d1, .lit "yellow_x"] [])))
      , .existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") d2 (.and (governs d2 lr)

               (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var d2, .lit "do_not_enter"] [])))
      , .existsDevice (.lit "temporary_traffic_control") d3 (governs d3 lr)
      , .existsDevice (.lit "human_direction") d4 (allOf

          , .atom "dev_human_direction_role" [.var d4, .lit "police_officer"] []
          , .atom "dev_human_direction_indication" [.var d4, .lit "stop"] [] ]) ]

def unexcused (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  .not (anyOf
    [ overtaking sfx
    , preparingLeftTurn sfx
    , inHovLaneComplying sfx
    , engagedInRoadWork
    , trafficTooClose sfx
    , obstructionOnRight sfx

  .existsUser c (allOf
    [ other c
    , member c aggMotorVehicle
    , .atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var c] []
    , .cmp (speedOf c) .gt (speedOf "subject") ])

/-- k4: a motor vehicle is still behind the subject in its lane. -/
def followedInLane (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let c := "follower" ++ sfx
  .existsUser c (allOf

    , member c aggMotorVehicle
    , .atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var c] [] ])

/-- k18: an authorized emergency vehicle on duty: a warning lamp flashing or rotating, or a siren. -/
def aevOnDuty : Formula :=
  .and (member "subject" aggEmergency) (anyOf
    [ flashingOrRotating "red"
    , flashingOrRotating "blue"
    , flashingOrRotating "amber"
    , flashingOrRotating "white"
    , .atom "sig_siren" [vSubject] [] ])

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_208_1

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pFollowingDecelDry : Term := .param "p.following_decel_dry"
def pFollowingDecelIce : Term := .param "p.following_decel_ice"
def pFollowingDecelWet : Term := .param "p.following_decel_wet"
def pFollowingHeadwayDry : Term := .param "p.following_headway_dry"
def pFollowingHeadwayIce : Term := .param "p.following_headway_ice"
def pFollowingHeadwayWet : Term := .param "p.following_headway_wet"
def pLeftLaneMoveOverTime : Term := .param "p.left_lane_move_over_time"
def pOvertakeSameDirectionCos : Term := .param "p.overtake_same_direction_cos"
def pOvertakeWindow : Term := .param "p.overtake_window"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- k3: "two or more … lanes": the text's literal. -/
def twoLanes : Term := .lit (Units.ratio 2 1) .count

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helpers
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def allOf : List Formula → Formula
  | [] => .tt
  | [φ] => φ
  | φ :: rest => .and φ (allOf rest)

def anyOf : List Formula → Formula
  | [] => .ff
  | [φ] => φ
  | φ :: rest => .or φ (anyOf rest)

def aggMotorVehicle : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle"
def aggVehicle : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"
def aggHighOccupancy : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-460-2::high_occupancy_vehicle"
def aggTraffic : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"
def aggEmergency : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle"

def member (x agg : String) : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [.var x, .lit agg] []
def occupies (x r : String) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [.var x, .var r] []
def governs (d r : String) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [.var d, .var r] []
def speedOf (x : String) : Term := .measure "kin_speed" [.var x]
/-- A road user other than the subject. -/
def other (x : String) : Formula := .not (.same (.var x) vSubject)

/-- sig.warning_lamp of a colour in a mode, on the subject. -/
def lamp (colour mode : String) : Formula := .atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vSubject, .lit colour, .lit mode] []
def flashingOrRotating (colour : String) : Formula := .or (lamp colour "flashing") (lamp colour "rotating")

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class, place
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := member "subject" aggMotorVehicle

/-- k2: the subject occupies a controlled-access highway. -/
def onControlledAccess (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "controlled_access") ("ca" ++ sfx) (occupies "subject" ("ca" ++ sfx))

/-- k3, k4: the subject occupies a lane that is first from the left of two or more lanes in its
    direction. -/
def inExtremeLeftLane (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let l := "lane" ++ sfx
  let n := "leftNeighbour" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") l (allOf
    [ occupies "subject" l
    , .cmp (.measure "st_lane_adjacency" [.var l, .lit "count"]) .ge twoLanes
    , .not (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") n (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var l, .lit "left", .var n] [])) ])

/-- k5: the subject's speed is below the value of a maximum speed-limit sign governing a travel
    region it occupies. -/
def belowPostedLimit (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let d := "limitSign" ++ sfx
  let r := "portion" ++ sfx
  .existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_sign") d (allOf
    [ .atom "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind" [.var d, .lit "maximum"] []
    , .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") r (.and (occupies "subject" r) (governs d r))
    , .cmp (speedOf "subject") .lt (.measure "dev_speed_limit_sign_value" [.var d]) ])

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exceptions read inside S
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- k9: within the window ahead, the subject overtakes and passes another vehicle. -/
def overtaking (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let c := "passed" ++ sfx
  .within .time pOvertakeWindow "subject" (.existsUser c (allOf
    [ other c
    , member c aggVehicle
    , .derived "drv_interaction_overtake_pass" [vSubject, .var c] [pOvertakeWindow, pOvertakeSameDirectionCos] ]))

/-- k10, k11: the subject's declared plan includes a left turn at an intersection. -/
def preparingLeftTurn (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let i := "turnAt" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") i (.intent "int.left_turn" vSubject (.var i))

/-- k12, k13a, k13b: the subject travels in a high-occupancy lane, is a high-occupancy vehicle, and
    the conditions of every high-occupancy-lane zone sign governing that lane hold for it. -/
def inHovLaneComplying (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let r := "hovLane" ++ sfx
  let z := "hovSign" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "reserved_lane") r (allOf
    [ occupies "subject" r
    , .atom "st_reserved_lane_class" [.var r, .lit "high_occupancy"] []
    , member "subject" aggHighOccupancy
    , .forallDevice (.lit "zone_sign") z
        (.implies
          (.and (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [.var z, .lit "high_occupancy_lane"] []) (governs z r))
          (.derived "prim_conditions_hold" [.var z, vSubject] [])) ])

/-- k14: a highway-maintenance vehicle at work: amber warning lamp flashing or rotating. -/
def engagedInRoadWork : Formula :=
  allOf
    [ .atom "ru_official_vehicle" [vSubject] []
    , .atom "ru_official_vehicle_kind" [vSubject, .lit "highway_maintenance"] []
    , flashingOrRotating "amber" ]

/-- k16 operationalization: the stopping distance S_stop = speed × H + speed² / (D + D). -/
def stopping (h d : Term) : Term :=
  .add (.mul (speedOf "subject") h) (.div (.mul (speedOf "subject") (speedOf "subject")) (.add d d))

def surfaceIcy : Formula := .atom "env_ice_or_snow" [] []
def surfaceWet : Formula := .or (.atom "env_wet_road" [] []) (.atom "env_precipitation" [] [])

def stoppingDistance : Term :=
  .cond surfaceIcy (stopping pFollowingHeadwayIce pFollowingDecelIce)
    (.cond surfaceWet (stopping pFollowingHeadwayWet pFollowingDecelWet)
      (stopping pFollowingHeadwayDry pFollowingDecelDry))

/-- The lane to the right of a lane the subject occupies, and what holds of it. -/
def rightLaneOf (sfx : String) (body : String → Formula) : Formula :=
  let ls := "ownLane" ++ sfx
  let lr := "rightLane" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") ls (.and (occupies "subject" ls)
    (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") lr
      (.and (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var ls, .lit "right", .var lr] []) (body lr))))

/-- k15, k16 (traffic conditions): a traffic member in the right neighbouring lane within S_stop
    of the subject, longitudinally. -/
def trafficTooClose (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  rightLaneOf ("T" ++ sfx) fun lr =>
    let c := "beside" ++ sfx
    .existsUser c (allOf
      [ other c
      , member c aggTraffic
      , occupies c lr
      , .cmp (.measure "rel_surface_gap" [vSubject, .var c, .lit "longitudinal"]) .lt stoppingDistance ])

/-- k15, k16 (obstructions or hazards): an obstruction on the subject's right within S_stop. -/
def obstructionOnRight (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let o := "obstacle" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "obstruction") o (.and
    (.cmp (.measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [vSubject, .var o]) .lt stoppingDistance)
    (.cmp (.quantity "prim_region_lateral_offset" [vSubject, .var o] []) .lt zeroMetres))

/-- k15, k16 (inclement weather): visibility below S_stop. -/
def visibilityShort : Formula := .cmp (.measure "env_visibility" []) .lt stoppingDistance

/-- k17: a device or a peace officer governing the lane to the right closes it. -/
def rightLaneClosed (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  rightLaneOf ("C" ++ sfx) fun lr =>
    let d1 := "laneSignal" ++ sfx
    let d2 := "closureSign" ++ sfx
    let d3 := "works" ++ sfx
    let d4 := "officer" ++ sfx
    anyOf
      [ .existsDevice (.lit "lane_control_signal") d1 (.and (governs d1 lr)
          (.or (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var d1, .lit "red_x"] [])
               (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var d1, .lit "yellow_x"] [])))
      , .existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") d2 (.and (governs d2 lr)
          (.or (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var d2, .lit "closed_to_traffic"] [])
               (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var d2, .lit "do_not_enter"] [])))
      , .existsDevice (.lit "temporary_traffic_control") d3 (governs d3 lr)
      , .existsDevice (.lit "human_direction") d4 (allOf
          [ governs d4 lr
          , .atom "dev_human_direction_role" [.var d4, .lit "police_officer"] []
          , .atom "dev_human_direction_indication" [.var d4, .lit "stop"] [] ]) ]

/-- None of the exceptions of subsection 2 (a)(1)-(4), (b), (c) holds. -/
def unexcused (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  .not (anyOf
    [ overtaking sfx
    , preparingLeftTurn sfx
    , inHovLaneComplying sfx
    , engagedInRoadWork
    , trafficTooClose sfx
    , obstructionOnRight sfx
    , visibilityShort
    , rightLaneClosed sfx ])

/-- S: the subject is in the extreme left lane of a controlled-access highway of two or more lanes,
    slower than the posted maximum, and unexcused. -/

  allOf [ onControlledAccess sfx, inExtremeLeftLane sfx, belowPostedLimit sfx, unexcused sfx ]

/-- k6, O: a faster motor vehicle behind the subject in its lane. -/
def overtakenFromRear (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let c := "rear" ++ sfx
  .existsUser c (allOf
    [ other c
    , member c aggMotorVehicle
    , .atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var c] []
    , .cmp (speedOf c) .gt (speedOf "subject") ])

/-- k4: a motor vehicle is still behind the subject in its lane. -/
def followedInLane (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let c := "follower" ++ sfx
  .existsUser c (allOf
    [ other c
    , member c aggMotorVehicle
    , .atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var c] [] ])

/-- k18: an authorized emergency vehicle on duty: a warning lamp flashing or rotating, or a siren. -/
def aevOnDuty : Formula :=
  .and (member "subject" aggEmergency) (anyOf
    [ flashingOrRotating "red"
    , flashingOrRotating "blue"
    , flashingOrRotating "amber"
    , flashingOrRotating "white"
    , .atom "sig_siren" [vSubject] [] ])

/-- Applicability: k2, k3/k4 (place), not k18, not k20. -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  allOf
    [ onControlledAccess "A"
    , inExtremeLeftLane "A"
    , .not aevOnDuty
    , .not (.asm "asm.within_city_or_town_limits") ]

  .not (.and
    (.holdsFor .time pLeftLaneMoveOverTime "subject"
      (.since (stays "S") (.and (overtakenFromRear "O") (stays "R"))))
    (followedInLane "F"))

  .within .time pOvertakeWindow "subject" (.existsUser c (allOf
    [ other c
    , member c aggVehicle
    , .derived "drv_interaction_overtake_pass" [vSubject, .var c] [pOvertakeWindow, pOvertakeSameDirectionCos] ]))

/-- k10, k11: the subject's declared plan includes a left turn at an intersection. -/
def preparingLeftTurn (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let i := "turnAt" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") i (.intent "int.left_turn" vSubject (.var i))

/-- k12, k13a, k13b: the subject travels in a high-occupancy lane, is a high-occupancy vehicle, and
    the conditions of every high-occupancy-lane zone sign governing that lane hold for it. -/
def inHovLaneComplying (sfx : String) : Formula :=
  let r := "hovLane" ++ sfx
  let z := "hovSign" ++ sfx
  .existsRegion (.lit "reserved_lane") r (allOf
    [ occupies "subject" r
    , .atom "st_reserved_lane_class" [.var r, .lit "high_occupancy"] []
    , member "subject" aggHighOccupancy
    , .forallDevice (.lit "zone_sign") z
        (.implies
          (.and (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [.var z, .lit "high_occupancy_lane"] []) (governs z r))
          (.derived "prim_conditions_hold" [.var z, vSubject] [])) ])

def engagedInRoadWork : Formula :=
  allOf
    [ .atom "ru_official_vehicle" [vSubject] []
    , .atom "ru_official_vehicle_kind" [vSubject, .lit "highway_maintenance"] []
    , flashingOrRotating "amber" ]

  .add (.mul (speedOf "subject") h) (.div (.mul (speedOf "subject") (speedOf "subject")) (.add d d))

def surfaceWet : Formula := .or (.atom "env_wet_road" [] []) (.atom "env_precipitation" [] [])

  let lr := "rightLane" ++ sfx

    let d2 := "closureSign" ++ sfx
    let d3 := "works" ++ sfx

      [ .existsDevice (.lit "lane_control_signal") d1 (.and (governs d1 lr)
          (.or (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var d1, .lit "red_x"] [])
               (.atom "dev_lane_control_signal_state" [.var d1, .lit "yellow_x"] [])))
      , .existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") d2 (.and (governs d2 lr)
          (.or (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var d2, .lit "closed_to_traffic"] [])
               (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var d2, .lit "do_not_enter"] [])))
      , .existsDevice (.lit "temporary_traffic_control") d3 (governs d3 lr)
      , .existsDevice (.lit "human_direction") d4 (allOf

          , .atom "dev_human_direction_role" [.var d4, .lit "police_officer"] []
          , .atom "dev_human_direction_indication" [.var d4, .lit "stop"] [] ]) ]

    , preparingLeftTurn sfx
    , inHovLaneComplying sfx

    , .atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var c] []

    , flashingOrRotating "blue"
    , flashingOrRotating "amber"
    , flashingOrRotating "white"
    , .atom "sig_siren" [vSubject] [] ])

  .add (.mul (speedOf "subject") h) (.div (.mul (speedOf "subject") (speedOf "subject")) (.add d d))

def surfaceWet : Formula := .or (.atom "env_wet_road" [] []) (.atom "env_precipitation" [] [])

  .cond surfaceIcy (stopping pFollowingHeadwayIce pFollowingDecelIce)

      , member c aggTraffic

      , .cmp (.measure "rel_surface_gap" [vSubject, .var c, .lit "longitudinal"]) .lt stoppingDistance ])

# NRS_484B_208_1 — task result

## Final verdict
**UNANCHORED_VARIABLE** (expected on the final files; this was the result of gate run 2, which is the formula left in place). The node is wrong in two places, described below. The rule and the 19 witnesses are written in full. Every witness except `branch_4` passed in a diagnostic run.

## Gate runs (4 of 6 used)
1. **Skeleton, before any edit** → `UNUSED_CLAIM` (all claims; the formulas were still `.tt`). This run was wasted.
2. **Full rule and witnesses** → `UNANCHORED_VARIABLE`: `turnAtS`, `turnAtR`, which are the intersection region of k10/k11 inside the two copies of S. The rule builds and passes the static check.
3. **Diagnostic**: anchored the intersection with `st_region_geometry_distance(subject, ix) ≥ 0` → still `UNANCHORED_VARIABLE`. The gate refuses this vacuous anchor, correctly.
4. **Diagnostic**: anchored it with `rel_occupies(subject, ix)` (wrong meaning, used only to reach the witness stage) → `WITNESS_FAIL`:
   - `branch_4: expected not_applicable, got unknown for [aggregate_unresolved:DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle]`
   - `branch_7: expected compliant, got violated`. This failure comes only from the diagnostic anchor (the subject is not in the intersection).
   - Every other witness passed: forbid, permit, idle, blind, and branches 1–3 and 5–15.

   After run 4 I reverted k10/k11 to the record's formula: `existsRegion intersection ix (intent int.left_turn subject ix)`.

## Node defects (for the plan agent)

### 1. k10/k11: the intersection region has no anchor
The record binds the target region of `int.left_turn` with "the intention's region quantifier" (element k11 claims only `st.intersection`). The gate does not count `intent` as tying a region to a binder, and k11 claims no anchoring atom (`rel.occupies`, `st.region_geometry` with a bound, `dev.governs`). A vacuous distance anchor is refused, and occupancy changes the meaning.

**Fix:** claim an anchor for k11 that the words support. For example, use `st.region_geometry` (`st_region_geometry_distance(subject, ix)`) with a reviewed distance parameter for "preparing … at an intersection", meaning the intersection ahead lies within that distance. Alternatively, use an occupied lane that enters it (`st.lane_enters`). Otherwise, have the gate accept `intent(subject, ix)` as an anchor.

### 2. k18 (and k14): the reading resolves no class as an authorized emergency vehicle
Under this run's reading, `DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle` includes no class, and every motor-vehicle class (including `ru.emergency_vehicle`) is unresolved. So for any subject that is a motor vehicle, membership is at best `aggregate_unresolved`.

- **Planned `branch_4`** (an authorized emergency vehicle with lamps flashing, expected `not_applicable`) can only be **unknown**. This was confirmed in run 4.
- **k14** ("engaged in … maintenance", read as an amber warning lamp flashing or rotating) can never be decided either. Such a lamp also satisfies k18's "warning lamp flashing or rotating", so the applicability's `¬(AEV ∧ lamp)` stays unknown for every highway-maintenance vehicle with its lamp on. No decided witness can show the k14 exception, so I added none. I expect `VACUOUS` on the k14 leaves once (1) is fixed; this is predicted, not verified.

**Fix:** have the reading include at least `ru.emergency_vehicle`, and probably `ru.fire_apparatus`, in `DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle`. That makes branch_4 reachable and lets a non-emergency maintenance vehicle be decided as not an AEV. Alternatively, re-plan branch_4's expected verdict and the k14 reading.

## Choices the node left open
- **Leftmost lane (k3/k4)**: written as "there is no lane `l'` with `st_lane_adjacency(l, "left", l')`". Core decides this false for every `l'` exactly when the lane is first from the left with no left neighbour, so it reads the record's "ordinal first" without a figure the text doesn't state. "Two or more" is `st_lane_adjacency(l, "count") ≥ Units.ratio 2 1` (the declared literal, unit `.count`).
- **Stopping distance (k16)**: `speed × H + speed² / (D + D)`. The convention's 2 × D is written as D + D, so no undeclared figure enters. H and D are selected by `cond`: ice first, then wet or rain, then dry.
- **"The lane to the right" (k15/k17)**: the right neighbour (`st_lane_adjacency(ls, "right", lr)`) of a lane the subject occupies.
- **"Another vehicle" / "traffic member" / "motor vehicle behind"**: each excludes the subject (`¬ same`).
- **AEV "warning lamp flashing or rotating"**: any colour, as the record says. The lamp atom needs a colour, so I wrote one disjunct per colour and mode.
- **HOV (k13a)**: "for every zone sign of kind high_occupancy_lane governing the lane" is an implication under `forallDevice`, as the record states.
- I added no narrowings: every choice above stays within the record's own wording.

## Witness design notes
- In the base timeline the subject is in the middle lane at t = 0 and in the leftmost lane from t = 1. This keeps the obligation's `since` from starting on unrecorded history. Without it, permit and blind could only report a truncation unknown.
- `blind` is judged on 0–20 s, so S's look-ahead window (overtaking) is never truncated. `branch_6` (overtake) is judged on 0–14 s, before the move-over window has run again after the pass.
- Branches 5–15 each excuse the subject through exactly one exception, against a scene that would otherwise be violated: traffic, overtake, left turn, HOV, obstruction, wet road, rain, ice, lane-control signal, regulatory sign, temporary traffic control, police officer.

## Why I finished
The node is wrong. The quantifier in k10/k11 can't be anchored with what the node claims, and the reading makes the planned `branch_4` (and k14) undecidable. Neither can be repaired in Lean without changing the record's meaning. Two gate runs remain unused.
